name: devsuite
description: Shared code-analysis engine + focused VS Code extensions (RepoPilot, DevImpact, CodeGuard, TraceLens, BugTrail)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @devsuite/core && npm run build -w repopilot -w devimpact -w codeguard -w tracelens -w bugtrail
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w repopilot -w devimpact -w codeguard -w tracelens -w bugtrail
scripts.package:all: npm run package -w repopilot -w devimpact -w codeguard -w tracelens -w bugtrail
